claim.quote: The invariant-mass spectrum of $e^+ e^-$ pairs produced in $^{12}$C+$^{12}$C collisions at an incident energy of 2 GeV per nucleon has been measured for the first time.

name: HADES dielectron production in 12C+12C collisions at 2 AGeV

summary.plain: HADES's first physics result: the first measurement of the invariant-mass spectrum of electron-positron pairs from carbon-carbon collisions at 2 GeV per nucleon, over five orders of magnitude, showing an excess over pion and eta decays above 0.15 GeV/c^2.
summary.technical: Invariant-mass spectrum of e+e- pairs in 12C+12C at 2 GeV per nucleon measured for the first time; Dalitz decays of pi0 and eta account for the yield up to 0.15 GeV/c^2 but only about 50% above; the excess is likely from baryon-resonance and vector-meson decays.

title: Dielectron production in 12C+12C collisions at 2 AGeV with HADES
why_it_matters: Resolved the 'DLS puzzle' of the earlier Bevalac data and set the baseline for the Au+Au measurements.
